text:
Devon Levi is 7-1-0, back from injured reserve, and Oilers Nation is already asking whether he has become Edmonton's go-to goalie. The record says yes. The shot quality says slow down. Across eight starts he has allowed 24 goals on chances worth 22.89, which is 1.11 goals below expected (goals saved above expected measures saves beyond what the shot quality predicts).

The weak spot is the dangerous stuff. He has stopped 75% of high-danger shots, 16th percentile, against a league rate of 81%. Edmonton has scored enough to cover for it so far, and his last five starts were better (1.06 above expected), with the season number dragged down by one rough opener in Vancouver.

Levi's path is the interesting part: a seventh-round pick in 2020, MVP of the CCHL in junior A, then a .952 save percentage at Northeastern. That pedigree is why people expect more. Our talent range has him around .880 to .900, average-ish, and the honest verdict for now is a goalie riding a strong team. We'd watch his high-danger stops before calling the job his.
headline: Levi's record is running ahead of his saves
